bifrost: No app-facing record-sync SDK. Local pieces: springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs, keychain.rs, share.rs, url.rs; ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud (server-side contacts/calendar sync)
summary: BifrOSt has no generic record database, subscriptions or sync engine for apps. The cloud service in bifrost-cloud syncs contacts and calendar over ETag/If-Match HTTP APIs, and the shell backs up data to a local file.

features.note: Built 2026-10-17: SyncEngine::push and resolve now work on any Remote store, not only the local Database, and CloudZone implements Remote over the cloud records table: a stale change tag becomes a record-changed conflict with the cloud's version, settled with keep-local, keep-server or merge. Tests: record_sync::tests::a_remote_store_takes_the_same_queue_and_conflicts and cloud_records::tests::save_then_stale_save_is_a_conflict_on_the_cloud. Still partial: the data API has no compare-and-swap, so two devices writing between the read and the write can both pass the check; no app is wired yet. The signed-in user's identity (record name, display name, sign-up address, admin flag) is read from the cloud answer to GET /me and mapped to typed errors, tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-07.rs. Gap: the service has no lookup by address, so an app cannot discover another user, and the caller performs the request. Checked 2026-10-17: nothing to build in BifrOSt until bifrost-cloud has a lookup route; that change belongs to the server repo. Blocked on the server (2026-10-17): bifrost-cloud has no lookup-by-address route, so an app cannot find another user. That change belongs in the server repo; nothing is built here.

features.note: Built 2026-10-17: backup archives are encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305 (format SBBK2, random 256-bit key kept in the shell keychain under bifrost.backup, random 24-byte nonce in the header, header as associated data). Version 1 (SBBK1) archives still restore without a key. Settings > Backup > Delete All Backups (confirmed) removes the archives and keeps the live data. Tests: shell::backup::tests (round trip, tampered archive, wrong key, version 1 restore, staged encrypted restore, delete). Still partial: the archive key stays on this device (no escrow, so a new device cannot open old archives), the keychain is not iCloud-synced (docs/bifrost-ui.md), and the tests have not run on the VM or Midget.
